{{Top|leg}}
A '''pressure resuscitator''' was a medical tool that assisted with breathing. The resuscitator was affixed over a patient's face, allowing a decompression tube to automatically enter the trachea and feed into the [[Lung/Legends|lungs]]. After suffering a venticular fibrillation, [[Morgan Q. Raventhorn]] was treated with a pressure resuscitator by [[Maglenna Pendower]] in an effort to restart Raventhorn's breathing. Used together with an [[adrenaline patch]] and [[adhesive defrib strip]], Pendower was successful in saving Raventhorn's life.<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
